# Third-Party Vendored Runtime Libraries

This directory contains vendored client-side runtime libraries used exclusively by [`documentation.html`](../../documentation.html) for fast, zero-dependency offline rendering.

| Library | File | Version | License | Upstream Repository |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Marked** | `marked.min.js` | 12.0.2 | MIT | [https://github.com/markedjs/marked](https://github.com/markedjs/marked) |
| **PrismJS** | `prism.bundle.js` | 1.29.0 | MIT | [https://github.com/PrismJS/prism](https://github.com/PrismJS/prism) |
| **Mermaid** | `mermaid.min.js` | 10.9.0 | MIT | [https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid](https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid) |

Full license notices, copyright headers, and source attributions are maintained in [THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md](../../THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md).

These vendor assets can be updated or re-downloaded at any time using [`automation-scripts/download_vendor_assets.py`](../../automation-scripts/download_vendor_assets.py).
